name: 侠客梦
group_note: same jinyongmeng (jym, 147) lineage/simul_efun composition -- reimplemented efun::tail() the same way (§6.2); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds (dropped the +=128 byte-mutation leftover, made is_chinese() enforcement per-character); guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() against the reentrant-compile crash; fixed quit.lpc's unguarded environment(me) crash; fixed message.lpc's tell_room() exc_target=0 crash (AGENTS.md §7.12). New bug not present in jym: get_id() unconditionally registered input_to("get_passwdd",...) for ANY wiz_level>0 id -- including a BRAND NEW account that has just been granted wizard status but has no save file yet (exactly the situation admin-seeding creates) -- without checking whether a save file exists and without returning, so the very next input got silently diverted into get_passwdd()'s password check against an unset password, always failing with "密码错误" and destructing the connection. Fixed by gating the early registration on file_size(save_file)>=0 (matching the later, correct check in the same function) and adding the missing return. This is a real bug in the archived source, not something the admin-seeding process introduced -- it would affect any real deployment that grants wizard status to a not-yet-registered id. Also found the registration flow includes an additional QQ-number prompt and a 玩家守则 (player rules) y/n confirmation step not present in the jym sibling -- read the actual input_to() chain per AGENTS.md §8.2 rather than assuming jym's exact send sequence carries over.
